Title: Okinawa: Kayak Mangroves & Ocean Native-English Private Tour
Description:
Discover the breathtaking beauty of the Yambaru region in Northern Okinawa with a kayak tour guided by a native English-speaker. Whether you want to get amongst the mangroves to learn about the unique adaptations of this incredible ecosystem or paddle over the coral reef, this private tour caters to your group's skill level, we will contact you after booking to curate a personalized experience that meets your needs and ensures a memorable outing.

We'll meet you at a suitable location where you can change and grab a drink before heading to the launch site. We'll provide you with a brief introduction to kayaking before you embark on your adventure.
The launch location and exploration routes will depend on weather and sea conditions, as well as your group's abilities. Our tour may include visits to picturesque spots such as Kouri Island, Nakijin Reef, Yagaji Sea Valley, or Haneji Inland Sea, where you can explore secret beaches, mangroves, and remote islands.

Title: Okinawa: Kayak & Snorkel, Private Tour in Yanbaru
Description:
Explore Okinawa with this incredible private ocean tour in Yanbaru, kayak along a lagoon and reef in north Okinawa to an excellent snorkel location. A perfect opportunity to embrace the natural environment while exploring a quieter part of the island.

This Private tour will take you on an unforgettable journey along the untouched coastline, where you'll witness stunning views and experience the beauty of nature up close. You'll kayak over the crystal-clear water and past white sandy beaches, stopping to snorkel at locations which suit your group's ability and preferences.

Title: Snorkeling in Okinawa: Private booking
Description:
A private snorkelling adventure over coral reefs led by an SSI (Scuba Schools International) trained native English-speaking snorkel guide.
Tailored to your pace and comfort level, whether you're a confident swimmer or prefer a more relaxed experience, this beach entry allows us to adjust to your comfort level and conditions.

For those feeling adventurous, swim out to dramatic reef drop-offs where the ocean turns a deep, captivating blue. After your swim, enjoy a refreshing drink and a local snack, provided by your guide.

Instruction and guidance with snorkelling techniques and best practices is available.

Title: Okinawa's Gorgeous Beach & Snorkel Tour: Private & Customised
Description:
Discover the breathtaking beauty of the Yambaru region in Northern Okinawa with a multi-beach tour guided by a native English-speaker.

Join this private, pickup only, customisable tour and make your way to visit some of the best beaches and snorkel spots on the Motobu peninsular in North Okinawa.

Check out the tour details and either share your customisations and requests beforehand, or jump in and go with the flow. Whether it's popular tourist spots with amenities or rugged beaches with only sand and sea, we will curate a tour that fits your needs.

Our licenced snorkel guide can take you to areas suitable for your group's ability, from rock pool snorkelling to an outer reef adventures. After booking, we will contact you to learn about your specific preferences.

Title: Okinawa: Private Full Circle Island Kayak Tour Native-English
Description:
Paddle around Yagaji Island on a 14-kilometer kayak trip with your private group. Explore the island's diverse landscapes, including a river-like valley, rugged limestone islands, bridges, and mangrove bays.


Meet your guide and get a safety briefing and some basic paddling tips. Then, set off on your adventure. Kayak through a valley with steep jungle walls, under a very tall bridge, and out towards the sea and under the famous Kouri Bridge.


While not entering the deep sea, the east coast of Yagaji Island offers the chance to navigate past tiny islands and long white sand beaches before passing under the last bridge and into Haneji inland sea.


At a suitable break point, usually a nice sandy isolated beach, you'll be able to have a refreshing swim and enjoy the bento lunch we carry with us.


The inland sea is a very calm area providing a number of mangrove bays, where you'll be able to learn about and see various species of mangrove trees with their unique adaptations to living in a high salt environment.

Throughout the year, there are a variety of migratory bird species resident.


I can adjust the tour to suit your ages and abilities, and with the safety of the inland sea there are a number of different routes and adjustments to make it a fun and comfortable adventure.
